newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG, Gdanski jump as sale seen.
newsitem.headline: BIG, Gdanski jump as sale seen.

text.p: The main market's two top gainers on Tuesday, Bank Gdanski and bank BIG, jumped 5.7 percent and 4.3 percent respectively after a newspaper report that BIG would raise its stake in Gdanski on February 21.
"It's a reaction to the latest confirmation that BIG will up its stake in Bank Gdanski," one trader said, saying strong buying after price-fixing signalled more rises for the stocks.

BIG shares now cost 4.8 zlotys and Bank Gdanski's 46.5. The report in the daily Rzeczpospolita said BIG would pay 44 zlotys for its shares but no one at the banks or finance ministry would comment on the story.

BIG, which currently holds 31.2 percent of Gdanski shares directly and through two subsidiaries, is the only bidder for the treasury's offer of another 31.9 percent stake, or 6,260,240 shares, in Gdanski.
